modelOverview: First introduced in 1983 and named for the flexible, brick-link bracelet that echoes the fluid movement of Cartier's emblematic panther, the Panthère de Cartier was relaunched in 2017 with its distinctive square case, screwed bezel and rail-track Roman numeral dial. The Small model is the mid-size proportion of the modern range, sitting between the Mini and Medium/Large sizes, and is offered as an elegant unisex dress watch on a quartz movement.

WSPA0012.materials: Stainless steel case and steel brick-link bracelet
WSPA0012.bezel: Square polished steel bezel with signature exposed screws
WSPA0012.dial: Silvered dial with Roman numerals, rail-track minute ring and blued-steel sword-shaped hands
WSPA0012.description: The Panthère de Cartier Small in steel pairs the model's signature square case and screwed bezel with a silvered dial, Roman numerals and blued sword-shaped hands, worn on Cartier's flexible steel brick-link bracelet. Its crown is set with a synthetic blue spinel, a detail carried across the modern Panthère range. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

WJPN0057.materials: 18k yellow gold (750/1000) case set with 37 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.26ct); textured 18k yellow gold bracelet
WJPN0057.bezel: Square yellow gold bezel set with brilliant-cut diamonds
WJPN0057.dial: Golden grained dial with a sparkling effect, Roman numerals and gold-finish sword-shaped hands; octagonal yellow gold crown set with a brilliant-cut diamond (0.02ct)
WJPN0057.description: The WJPN0057 is the Small Panthère de Cartier in 18k yellow gold with a diamond-set case, its golden grained dial and gold-finish hands matched to a textured yellow gold bracelet. A brilliant-cut diamond replaces the usual spinel on the octagonal crown. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

variants.Yellow Gold – Diamonds: Small Panthère de Cartier in 18k yellow gold with 37 brilliant-cut diamonds on the case, a golden grained dial with gold-finish sword hands and a diamond-set crown, on the textured yellow gold bracelet.

WJPN0061.description: The WJPN0061 is the Small Panthère de Cartier in 18k rose gold with diamonds on both case and bracelet: 36 brilliant-cut stones frame the silver dial and a further 142 are semi-set into the flexible brick-link bracelet. The octagonal crown carries a single brilliant-cut diamond. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

WJPN0062.materials: 18k rose gold (750/1000) case set with 36 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.25ct); 18k rose gold double-loop bracelet semi-set with 286 brilliant-cut diamonds (2.59ct)
WJPN0062.bezel: Square rose gold bezel set with brilliant-cut diamonds
WJPN0062.dial: 18k rose gold dial set with 172 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.47ct) with rose gold-finish sword-shaped hands; octagonal rose gold crown set with a brilliant-cut diamond (0.02ct)
WJPN0062.description: Note: Cartier's specification for reference WJPN0062 is 18k rose gold rather than white gold. It is the most heavily set Small Panthère in the range, with a fully diamond-paved rose gold dial, a diamond-set case and crown, and a double-loop rose gold bracelet semi-set with 286 brilliant-cut diamonds. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
